Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
feat(SideCar): Initialize shared telemetry pipeline and adopt Common traits

Integrate the Common crate into the SideCar binary to initialize the shared dual-pipe telemetry system (PostHog + OTLP) at startup. This change adds a synchronous bootstrap in `main.rs` that spins up a temporary Tokio runtime to execute the async `CommonLibrary::Telemetry::Initialize` routine, ensuring metrics are captured before the Node.js download or spawn processes begin.

Additionally, minor documentation and formatting cleanups were performed: updated `Cargo.toml` to declare the new `Common` dependency, refined JSDoc in `dns-override.js` to match the `Resolve` environment variable convention, and aligned `CHANGELOG.md` formatting with the project's voice.

This establishes the observability foundation for the SideCar element, aligning it with the architectural telemetry standards defined in the Common layer.

Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
docs(SideCar): Rewrite CHANGELOG with narrative release history
